description:
Join Apple's HID sensing and interaction algorithms team, which develops advanced sensing algorithms that enable best-in-class user experiences across Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Pencil, Apple Watch, and exciting new products. We are looking for a machine learning engineer with hands-on generative AI experience and a strong foundation in signal processing, who is excited to apply both to how people interact with Apple products.

Our team draws from diverse backgrounds: signal processing, machine learning, firmware, software engineering, physics, human factors, and more; all dedicated to inventing new ways users interact with Apple products. You will work at the intersection of hardware, software, and design, collaborating with specialists across Apple to ship extraordinary products to millions of users every year.

Description
In this role, you will help explore how generative AI can advance sensing and interaction. You will research, develop, and evaluate generative models and AI systems for physical signals such as time series and images. Success here is measured by real-world impact on products and users, not by leaderboard numbers. That takes a deep understanding of the signals you model and statistical rigor in how you judge results. These are challenging, open-ended problems, and we are looking for someone with the persistence to carry an idea all the way into production.

You will also bring a solid understanding of physical signals and signal processing, and use it to develop sensing algorithms for products. You will collaborate with algorithm, firmware, and software engineers to deliver features from prototyping through production.

We value engineers who check their claims against real data, report negative results honestly, and explain technical findings clearly to people outside their field.

Responsibilities
Researching, developing, and evaluating generative models and AI systems for physical signals such as time series and images, and driving them from idea to production
Prototyping and developing sensing algorithms using signal processing and machine learning techniques for current and future products
Designing statistically sound evaluations that measure real-world impact rather than benchmark scores
Building data pipelines for large sensor datasets, including collection, labeling, and quality control
Turning research ideas into working prototypes quickly, with controlled and reproducible experiments
Working with firmware and software engineers throughout the product lifecycle, from early prototyping through production support
Communicating results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to team members, partner teams, and leadership

Minimum qualifications
BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field with a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry or research experience
Hands-on experience developing generative AI models or systems that go beyond tutorials, such as through shipped products, publications, or substantial projects
Experience working with real-world sensor or physical measurement data. Strong understanding of physical signals such as time series and images, and how their structure and noise shape what a model learns
Solid foundation in digital signal processing and time-series analysis, such as filtering, spectral analysis, and feature extraction
Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with a modern deep learning framework such as PyTorch

Preferred qualifications
MS or PhD in machine learning, signal processing, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field, with publications, open-source contributions, or shipped products in generative AI
Experience training generative or other ML models on time-series, sensor, audio, or image data, including at scale on GPU clusters
Statistical rigor in designing experiments and evaluations and in interpreting their results, backed by reproducible research practices
Experience using LLM-based AI assistants and agents to accelerate research and development work, such as coding, data analysis, and experiment automation
Proficiency in C/C++, and familiarity with embedded or resource-constrained systems
Demonstrated persistence in driving a challenging project from idea to production or real-world deployment
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills across algorithms, firmware, and software disciplines
